# Deepak Prasad — Senior Product Manager | Subscription Growth, Monetization & Applied AI

> Deepak Prasad is a Senior Product Manager with 7+ years across consumer subscriptions, AI features, payments and marketplaces. Founding member of the Sportstech product team and its first PM: took a free app to about 15K paying subscribers in under 3 years, shipped an in-app AI coach (about 4,500 peak daily users) and redesigned onboarding and cancellation across the subscriber lifecycle. Owned the subscription business through ~15K paying subscribers, built payout systems moving ₹20–25 Cr a month, and led cross-border product teams across India and Europe. Available to join immediately in Bengaluru.

## Core Case Studies

- [ReshaMandi B2B Agri-Tech Marketplace](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/reshamandi): Digitised India's sericulture supply chain across 80,000+ farmers. Built instant payouts (from up to 15 days to seconds for standard payouts and under 2 hours for large ones), real-time cocoon bidding driving repeat participation, and human-in-the-loop image price recommendation piloted at 2 centres. Disbursements grew from about ₹10–15 Cr to ₹20–25 Cr a month.
- [Building a Conversational AI Coach](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/ai-coach): 0→1 in-app AI coach scaling from ~300 to a peak of ~4,500 DAU after November 2025 launch. Multi-model architecture with Gemini as primary model, ChatGPT as fallback, and deterministic code-level checks for high-risk queries. Kept text for planning before a workout and voice during it.
- [Turning a Free Fitness App into a Subscription Business](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/subscription): Built subscription monetization from 0 to about 15K paying subscribers, taking yearly plans to 87% of paying subscribers. Co-authored the FY2025 analysis showing monthly plans lost subscribers far faster than annual plans.
- [Holistic Performance Score (Product Strategy & PRD)](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/performance-score): Cross-platform PRD uniting wearable, mobile, and connected fitness telemetry into a single Athletic Reliability Performance Score (unlaunched development-ready PRD).
- [Scaling Content Localization with AI](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/ai-localization): AI-assisted content localization pipeline delivering 300+ workout videos across Italian, French, and Spanish in roughly 3 weeks (~10× faster, compressed from 3–4 months per market).
- [Behind the AI Copilot: Transparent In-Memory RAG](https://deepak-prasad.ai.studio/work/behind-copilot): In-memory cosine retrieval portfolio assistant with zero external database dependencies, 100% citation grounding, 95% (19 of 20) on golden eval set, and voice in 5 Indian languages via Sarvam AI proxy.

## Operating Principles

1. Ground Truth First: Spend time where the product is actually used — in mandis, on tracks, and with real end users.
2. Zero Friction by Design: Eliminate needless intermediate steps; high velocity comes from unblocking transactions and user intent.
3. MVP First, Iterate Relentlessly: Ship working software quickly to validate core value propositions before scaling architecture.
4. Go-To-Market from Day 0: Build product and distribution in tandem, partnering closely with sales, marketing, and operations.
5. Find High-Leverage Points: Deploy AI and automation where humans are strained or throttled, transforming operational bottlenecks into leverage.
6. Shared Ownership: High-trust team culture with clear context, continuous feedback, and transparent decision-making.
